6. Tipallatthamigajātaka The Triply Collapsed Deer: a past life story

“Migaṁ tipallatthamanekamāyaṁ, “About that deer—triply collapsed with many illusions, Aṭṭhakkhuraṁ aḍḍharattāpapāyiṁ; eight-hooved, a midnight drinker— Ekena sotena chamāssasanto, he’s breathing on the ground through one nostril! Chahi kalāhitibhoti bhāgineyyo”ti. Excelling with these six tricks, he deserves a chance.”

Tipallatthamigajātakaṁ chaṭṭhaṁ.
